summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, an obfuscated script (hex-named identifiers) that downloads the Bun v1.3.13 runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases for the detected platform (including musl detection via ldd/os-release), extracts the bun binary to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header '// @bun @bun-cjs') protected by a rotated string-array obfuscator (WV8StW rotator + hc1jfK9 decoder over a scrambled alphabet). Fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque, heavily obfuscated sibling script is unrelated to the package's advertised repo-config purpose and matches the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: the payload is executed by a runtime not invoked through Node, evading Node-based scanners. The legitimate @ornikar/repo-config in the ornikar/shared-configs monorepo does not ship setup.mjs, math_init.js, or a preinstall hook, indicating this version is a malicious release rather than the genuine package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
